availability_policy: Monthly average published early in the following month. The retrieval timestamp in this manifest is when the file was downloaded, which is an upper bound on availability for the last observation and says nothing about when earlier observations became available.
revision_policy: Rarely revised; corrections are possible. Not point-in-time. FRED serves only the current vintage of a series; revisions overwrite history in place and this endpoint exposes no vintage. Historical vintages exist in ALFRED (https://alfred.stlouisfed.org) and are not read by this module. A sha256 here identifies the file downloaded, not what the series looked like on any earlier date.
warnings: values are an annualised rate expressed as a decimal after dividing the published percent by 100, on a bond-equivalent, investment basis basis. This is a rate, not a period return: converting it to a monthly or daily return requires an explicit, recorded compounding or day-count assumption that this parser does not make.
series definition: Monthly average of the daily ten-year constant-maturity Treasury yield. A duration exposure, never a cash rate.
release timing: Monthly average published early in the following month.
revision behaviour: Rarely revised; corrections are possible.
transformation applied by the source: none (level, as published)
maturity: 120.0 months (construction: market_yield_at_constant_maturity). TB3MS, DGS3MO and DFF are not interchangeable; see fred.check_interchangeable.
